protocol.candidate: Only the exact inverse of the public SameSite production-line hunk from 8e2fc5f320633ddec0e99e05b65b21682ed3ccda; immutable prepared candidate file and manifest.
protocol.scope: All 471 original tests/unit/**/*.test.ts files discovered by unchanged jest.unit.config.ts; not the project integration suite.
protocol.target: auth.definition.ts cookie configuration should not use sameSite: none (weakens CSRF protection)

runtime.shared_package: Exact SHA512-matched original @wxyc/shared4.1.0, independently rebuilt from publisher source and environment
runtime.git_dependency: Original commit c27805bc50c424d9d6741e6a857ebbd85727e615; HTTPS transport to the same public repository may replace SSH transport without changing dependency content.

protocol.output_policy: All JSON, stdout, stderr, coverage and caches outside /work/project. Baseline/native may share the fresh per-repetition cache; independent arm has separate clean cache.
sequence: Fresh seed copy with relative workspace symlinks preserved; verify baseline Git/source/test/config/lock/installed dependency identities.
Execute full configured original unit baseline; require target guard actually passing and no failures/errors.
Apply only frozen candidate bytes; verify full candidate manifest.
Execute native selection and save actual original per-case outcomes, process status and raw logs.
Verify candidate identity, execute complete configured unit oracle without selection on identical candidate bytes, and verify final identity.
Export all raw evidence and metadata before temporary filesystem disappears.
protocol.eligibility: An unsuccessful baseline makes that repetition ineligible and prevents its candidate arms. Provisioning, setup, errors, skips and zero-call successes are never assertion-failure or nonempty-success evidence.
protocol.joint_witness: Every clean repetition must have a passing baseline, native exit0 with at least one original passing call and no failures/errors, independent assertion failure of the named original security source guard absent from native actual calls, unchanged tests/config/lock and identical candidate/dependency identities, followed by independent raw-evidence audit.
limits: Controlled historical-fix reversion with later original tests, not an authentic historical revision pair.
Original static security-configuration source guard, not runtime CSRF or exploitability.
Jest dependency-graph omission, not a testmon/Ekstazi CRC or fingerprint result.
Local isolated experiment, not hosted protected-baseline contributor validation.
Do not change the manuscript or remote repository before evidence and claims are independently audited.

os_prerequisite_correction.basis: Unchanged original script requires jq; explicit preserved-image probe confirms absent in v1.
os_prerequisite_correction.changes: Only the missing OS utility and necessary libraries; zero existing OS version changes. Original project, Node dependencies, test scope, candidate, flags and isolation unchanged.
